name: Scrivener Tove
title: Inks & Charts
examine: Spectacles, ink to the second knuckle, and the serene confidence of somebody whose maps have never gotten anyone lost.
lines: Deeds, charters, wills, and maps. I write all four and I keep a copy of all four.
Keep your own chart as you travel. A bought map only shows where the mapmaker went.
The Guildhall's records room and I disagree about seventeen boundary stones. I'm right about sixteen and stubborn about the last.
